description: Data for the project management, life cycle inventory, costings and energy production of a ground-mounted photovoltaic farm in Greece is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors George Tsinarakis. The data collected refer to the construction, costings, operation and environmental impacts of a photovoltaic farm and are provided in four separate Excel files with respect to their type and usage. Coverage: national (GR); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
